references.text: The prohibition against spreading false rumors and being an unjust witness is linked to a thorough investigation of testimony
The command to examine carefully and investigate thoroughly before a verdict is passed
Judges must investigate thoroughly when they hear about a serious case
The context that one witness is not enough, and the case must be examined carefully
A false witness who lies is something the Lord hates
A truthful witness speaks the truth, but a false witness speaks lies
A false witness shall not go unpunished; he who deals in falsehood shall not escape
A false witness shall not go unpunished, and he who deals in falsehood will perish
Two false witnesses accused Susanna with lies, but Daniel exposed them through a thorough investigation
The chief priests and the whole Council sought false testimony against Jesus
False witnesses stood up against Stephen with false accusations
